feature.atrStop: close minus k times ATR(14), Wilder smoothing, default 2x, on; a visual guide only, not a bot stop-loss
feature.panes: RSI 14 and MACD 12/26/9, off by default
feature.settings: Every indicator toggles on or off with bounded settings saved per viewer (robotMarketChart.v1, nested indicators v1)
feature.warmUp: The chart requests up to 1000 bars (for example BTCUSDT 1h 720, 2h 360) and draws the usual visible count
feature.isolation: Indicators never reach a bot, the Risk Manager, Preflight or any order

independentAudit.findings: No blocker, high or medium finding

activity.note: Natural growth; every change passed the tolerance rule and happened before the API restart, so the release did not cause it; the content of the new rows was not inspected in this release

browser.path: Owner signed in; root browser check
browser.pageLoads: i18n, chart-indicators and interactive-chart scripts with ?v=mc3
browser.defaults: EMA 50, EMA 200 and ATR stop 2.0x14 on; RSI and MACD off
browser.btcusdt1d: 245 visible bars with the three overlays, dashed forming-bar tails and a values list
browser.panes: RSI pane (70, 50 and 30 guides) and MACD pane (histogram, MACD and signal) appear when toggled and hide when off

limitations: Release upload, extraction and activation here cover chart v3 indicators 2919f9b on staging only.
The ATR stop line is a visual guide, not a bot stop-loss, and indicators never reach a bot, the Risk Manager, Preflight or any order.
Unchanged behavior of trading and research is shown by the delayed check, not by independent inspection of the new activity rows.
Future publication and activation require fresh facts and separate reviewed authority.
